lines: What if you fell into a hole, straight through the Earth?
No air. Heat-proof walls. You just fall.
Faster and faster. Over thirty thousand kilometers an hour.
And gravity? It gets a bit stronger, then drops to zero at the center.
Down here it's over five thousand degrees. As hot as the surface of the Sun.
Now Earth pulls you back, and you slow down.
Thirty-eight minutes later, you pop out on the other side of the planet.
Grab the edge, fast. Miss it, and you fall back. Forever.
